The HIGH findings the gate still reports live in third-party binaries already at their latest upstream release (npm's vendored tree at npm 12.0.2; moby/go-archive vendored by buildx 0.37.1) — there is no fixed build to move to and no unreachability argument to make, so they stay visible and clear when upstream republishes. Pin each product PURL to the exact version Trivy detects so a rebuild past the fix stops matching and forces re-review; prune statements whose PURLs no longer match anything. Never use .trivyignore.
